title: Airtable secret layouts outside the exact-field claim
summary: A Base64 value under a field whose name only resembles macSecretBase64, and a Base64 value with no field name.
rationale: The bounded claim is the exact documented field name. Other *Base64 fields are not generalised and a bare Base64 string has no carrier, so nothing here settles whether they are credentials.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted: the layouts are frozen as unsupported variants of the exact-field claim.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
